full_judgment:
S.K. Sinha, J: This petition at the instance of the defendants is for review of the judgment of this Division in Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 386 of 2009. Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 instituted Title Suit No. 226 of 2000 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Dhaka for declaration of their title in respect of schedule 'Kha' property and for nullity of the deed described in the schedule 'Ga' to the plaint. The trial Court on consideration of the materials on record decreed the suit. The petitioners unsuccessfully moved the lower appellate Court, the High Court Division and this Division against the decree passed in the suit and thereafter moved this review petition. 

 3. We have perused the judgments including the impugned judgment and noticed that at no stage of the proceedings the petitioners raised this point and it is for the first time they have raised this point in the review petition. The trial Court on proper assessment of the evidence on record decreed the suit and the appellate court also while affirming the decree assessed the evidence on record independently. The High Court Division also affirmed the judgment on assigning proper reasons. A review is by no means an appeal in disguise whereby an erroneous decision is reheard and corrected, but lies only for patent error. The scope for review is much more restricted than that of an appeal. The point raised in this petition is a new point, which could have been raised at the initial stage but the petitioners for reasons not known to us has not raised this point. There is no mistake or error on the face of the record to review the judgment of this Division. We find no merit in this petition, which is accordingly dismissed.
